rix.text: Elenda of Garrano finds the Immortal Sun in deserted Orazca, and she places herself in an enchanted sleep to guard it until Kumena reaches the city's gates and awakens both the city and Elenda.

A pale hand slides the tomb door aside and Saint Elenda emerges, telling Angrath and Huatli that she came only to retrieve what was hers, and lamenting that the Church turned her ritual into invasion.
When the Immortal Sun vanishes through Tezzeret's portal she refuses to help the Legion of Dusk recover it, and she tells her followers that they are free.
She explains that her order was meant to guard the Sun, not use it, rebukes Vona by forcing her to the floor with a magical command, and demands to be taken to Queen Miralda.
